name: Turbo Boat Simulator
summary: "Turbo Boat Simulator" puts you in control of a high-speed boat, deep in enemy territory, on a mission to escape in one piece. Allied planes drop map pieces into the water, all of which must be collected to complete each level. Gameplay is side-scrolling, allowing you to steer your boat up and down the screen and control your speed. The waterways are filled with obstacles, blockades, and narrow paths – much like in "Spy Hunter". Enemy boats and planes attack with gunfire and drop deadly mines as you fight to survive and stay on course.
